title: Sticky Date Pudding with Caramel Sauce
description: Microwave marvel — rich, sticky, and surprisingly fast.

ingredients.notes: divided: 100g for Pudding, 40g for Caramel Sauce
divided: 50g for Pudding, 150g for Caramel Sauce

method.instruction: Lightly grease a 2 litre microwave-safe glass bowl and set aside.
Shred carrot and apple using a grater. Set aside.
Place dates and boiling water in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, then remove from heat and stir in bi-carb soda. Set aside to cool.
In a large bowl, cream 100 g of the softened unsalted butter, 150 g white sugar, and 50 g of the brown sugar with an electric mixer on medium speed for about 3 minutes until light and fluffy.
Add eggs one at a time, beating for 2 minutes after each addition.
Fold in the cooled date mixture, shredded carrot, apple, sifted plain flour, and cinnamon. Mix just until combined — do not overmix.
Pour batter into the prepared bowl, cover with plastic wrap leaving a small vent, and microwave on medium-high for 10–13 minutes.
Let stand for 5 minutes after cooking. The pudding will continue to set during this time.

For the caramel sauce: combine the remaining 150 g of brown sugar, the remaining 40 g of unsalted butter, cream, and Grand Marnier in a microwave-safe bowl. Cook on high for 5 minutes, stirring every minute.
Let the sauce stand for a few minutes to thicken before serving.
Turn pudding out onto a serving plate. Drench generously with warm caramel sauce and serve with extra cream on the side.

notes.title: Microwave Power
notes.content: This recipe was tested in an 800W microwave. Adjust cooking time for different wattages — lower power needs longer, higher power needs shorter. Check at 10 minutes and add time in 1-minute increments if needed.

notes.title: Resting is Essential
notes.content: The 5-minute rest after cooking ensures a moist, tender pudding. Do not skip this step — the pudding continues to set during standing time.

notes.title: Serving Tip
notes.content: Best served warm with the caramel sauce poured over generously and a dollop of whipped cream or vanilla ice cream on the side.
